title: InstanceInfoReply
description: The parsed form of a instance_info reply (where an instance lives and what it has cost): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

worker.description: The worker the instance lives on, w<k>.

state.description: The worker's state, a name of the table's worker_states.

crashes.description: How many times the worker has crashed on the instance.

quarantined.description: 1 when the instance is quarantined, else 0.
